title: AI Control Layer Policy
description: Centralized policy configuration for the pi-based AI Control Layer. Top-level 'defaults' apply to every agent; entries under 'agents' override per-agent (section-level override, lists replace).

agents.description: Per-agent policy overrides keyed by hostname (must match the machine the pi agent runs on; short hostname). Sections present here override the same section in 'defaults'; omitted sections inherit. Lists replace, never merge.

identity.description: Cosmetic metadata only. Agent identity comes from the hostname; policy keys under 'agents' reference hostnames.

owner.description: Optional owner/team label used for grouping in the GUI.

banned.description: Commands matching these patterns are blocked; the agent is told the reason.

approval.description: Commands matching these patterns require human approval (local confirm, or remote via dashboard).

outputRedact.description: Commands whose stdout is matched against these glob patterns (comma-separated command, pattern applies to output): matching output is redacted before it reaches the model.

blocked.description: Paths the agent cannot read (also blocks edit/write/ls on them).

redact.description: Paths readable, but matching redactionPatterns are applied to content before it reaches the model.

approval.description: Paths readable only after human approval.

maxSessionCostUsd.description: Hard cap on cumulative session LLM cost (sum of message.usage.cost.total).

maxTurnCostUsd.description: Cost cap per turn (between user prompts).

maxSessionTokens.description: Hard cap on cumulative session tokens (sum of usage.totalTokens).

onExceed.description: 'block' refuses further LLM work; 'warn' notifies and continues.

maxTurnSeconds.description: Refuse further tool calls / LLM work once a turn exceeds this wall-clock time.

alertAfterSeconds.description: Raise a long-running alert (dashboard + notify) when a single tool execution exceeds this duration.

text.description: Governance text injected into (or replacing) the system prompt on every turn.

onDetect.description: 'block' strips/refuses the flagged content; 'warn' notifies and tags it.

patterns.description: Prompt-injection signature regexes. Extendable from the dashboard (signature feed).

url.description: WebSocket URL of the control plane / dashboard server.

localFallback.description: Behavior for approval-gated actions when the control plane is unreachable (fail mode).

id.description: Stable rule id; referenced by the audit log and the GUI.

pattern.description: Glob matched case-insensitively against the full command string. '*' any chars, '**' across separators, '~' expands to home. Comma-separated globs allowed.

reason.description: Human-readable reason, shown to the agent on block and to admins in the dashboard.

timeoutSeconds.description: Approval rules only: how long to wait for a human decision. null/0 = wait indefinitely. On timeout the action is blocked.

pattern.description: Glob matched case-insensitively against the resolved absolute path. '**' matches across directories, '~' expands to home. Comma-separated globs allowed.

timeoutSeconds.description: Approval rules only: human-decision timeout. null/0 = wait indefinitely.

pattern.description: Comma-separated file globs this redaction set applies to.

redactionPatterns.description: Regexes applied to file content before it reaches the model context.

regex.description: JavaScript-flavored regex. A leading '(?i)' is convention for case-insensitive.

replacement.description: Redaction rules only: replacement text, supports '$1' capture groups.
